user.title: Log in with your DHL account
user.description:
1. Open this link in Chrome or Edge and log in with your DHL account:

{authorize_url}

2. Open the developer console BEFORE or right after logging in (key F12 -> "Console" tab).

3. After login, a red message appears there: "Failed to launch 'dhllogin://...' because the scheme does not have a registered handler." The address bar stays unchanged - that's expected.

4. Right-click the blue dhllogin://-link INSIDE THAT MESSAGE -> "Copy link address". Do NOT use the URL from the address bar.

5. Paste the copied URL below.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew DHL login

error.invalid_code: Login failed. The code is invalid or expired - please open the link again and paste a fresh one.
error.no_code_in_url: No code found in the pasted URL. You probably copied the address bar instead of the dhllogin:// URL from the developer console - see the instructions above.

abort.already_configured: This DHL account is already configured.
